metadata.description: Developer tools for Drupal development, security, and deployment — Drupal, Docker, CI/CD, git, and security workflows.

plugins.name: drupal-dev-tools
plugins.description: Drupal 11 toolkit — audit command and skills for module development and security review

plugins.name: ddev-tools
plugins.description: DDEV local environment skills — drupal-ddev agent and operational workflows for Drupal 11 projects in DDEV

plugins.name: git-tools
plugins.description: Git workflow skills — worktrees for parallel, conflict-free work on multiple branches

plugins.name: security-tools
plugins.description: Security verification skills — OWASP ASVS v5.0 checklist mapped to Drupal 11 APIs and Semgrep SAST with custom Drupal rules for security code reviews

plugins.name: docker-tools
plugins.description: Docker skills for Drupal development — Compose stack authoring/operations and Docker Model Runner for local AI models

plugins.name: cicd-tools
plugins.description: CI/CD pipeline skills for Drupal projects — GitLab CI and GitHub Actions authoring, testing, Semgrep SAST with SARIF, and drush-based deployment

plugins.name: workflow-tools
plugins.description: Phased development workflows for Drupal projects — feature delivery, deployment, and tiny fixes with rigor scaled to risk

plugins.name: quality-tools
plugins.description: Design review skills — SOLID and DRY rules for code reviews — plus a phpstan hook that checks every edited custom Drupal PHP file
